description: Finish 4.0 Phase 25 — live-ready Stripe/checkout catalog ops: SKU sync floors, readiness probe, webhook idempotency, cutover checklist. Secrets never committed.
cutoverChecklist: Every active SKU has stripePriceId placeholder or STRIPE_PRICE_* override
Live without STRIPE_SECRET_KEY returns 503 (no sandbox fallback)
Webhook signature verify + idempotent replay of same event id
Stripe Dashboard webhook endpoint points at POST /v1/stripe/webhook
Replace price_test_* placeholders with live price ids before production traffic

manualOps.title: Sync store catalogs
manualOps.body: Run npm run billing:validate after adding cosmetics. Author tool shared/tools/author_stripe_ops_4.py mirrors entitlements into Play/web/checkout product tables.

manualOps.title: Map live Stripe prices
manualOps.body: Create Stripe Prices for each webProductId, then set stripePriceId or STRIPE_PRICE_<SKU> env overrides. Never commit live secret keys.

manualOps.title: Cut over to live mode
manualOps.body: Set CHECKOUT_API_MODE=live with STRIPE_SECRET_KEY + STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Confirm /v1/ops/readiness liveReady=true before pointing production traffic.

manualOps.title: Refund verify
manualOps.body: After a Stripe refund, confirm GET /v1/entitlements no longer returns the SKU for that cloudAccountId (or re-reconcile per entitlement-reconcile.json).
